 now 13.24 EST 90+3 min United pile forward again. Fernandes to Mount, who tries a one-two but sells his captain short.
 Share 37s ago 13.23 EST GOAL! Man United 3-4 Villa (Zirkzee 90+2)
 Ooh! A simple cross from Dorgu, a simple finish for Zirkzee. The last throw of the dice has worked.
 Share 2m ago 13.21 EST 90 min Fernandes tries to slip the ball in behinf fopr Mainoo, who has run out of puff. He’s been better than most in red shirts.
 Share 3m ago 13.20 EST 87 min United hit the bar! It’s Mount, timing his run like Frank Lampard and doing well to help Fernandes’ chip on its way.
 Share 4m ago 13.19 EST 87 min Lacey sends in a cross that is overhit. Behind the dotted line Carrick is pensive, Emery animated. I suspect the home crowd, fond as they are of Carrick, would now be happy to see Emery take his place.
 Share 6m ago 13.17 EST 87 min Unai Emery sends on his fifth sub, Madjo for Jackson. Barkley gets a shot away, saved by Lammens.
 Share 7m ago 13.17 EST 85 min Mount gives the ball away to Mbaye, who spares his blushes by returning the favour.
 Share 8m ago 13.15 EST 84 min Fernandes should be running the show, but it’s actually Ross Barkley. He sends a fine through ball down the right, where Dorgu has to pull off a sliding tackle.
 Share 10m ago 13.14 EST 83 min Michael Carrick decides it’s time for one last throw of the dice. He removes Mbeumo, who has been tireless but toothless, and sends on Joshua Zirkzee, who would be an unlikely saviour.
 Share 11m ago 13.13 EST 82 min A few United fans are trickling out. The rest are still making plenty of noise, but it feels as if they’re amusing themselves rather than rousing the troops for another famous fightback.
 Share 12m ago 13.12 EST 80 min Fernandes sends a through ball to Dorgu, who is too rusty to control it.
 Share 14m ago 13.10 EST 79 min Villa knock the ball around, which is all they have to do now to secure their fourth league win at Old Trafford in 70 years.
 Share 15m ago 13.09 EST 78 min Two more Villa subs, both alliterative: Mbaye for Manzambi, Gomes for Goretzka.
 Share 16m ago 13.08 EST 76 min Lacey wins a corner, which leads to another. Eventually there’s a half-chance for Mbeumo, who sends it wide.
 Share 17m ago 13.06 EST 75 min United’s passing has become disjointed, not that this is their biggest problem.
 Share 19m ago 13.04 EST 72 min … and another: Alysson off, Ross Barkley on. So three goalscorers have now left the stage.
 Share 20m ago 13.03 EST 71 min Villa sub: McGinn, after playing well and getting an assist as well as a penalty, gives way to George Hemmings…
 Share Updated at  13.03 EST 22m ago 13.02 EST 71 min A box shows that United have now conceded 30 goals this season, making them joint top of the Leakiest Defence League – in Europe. They share this dubious honour with Palace and Sassuolo.
 Share 22m ago 13.01 EST 70 min Cunha gets a shot on target, and then Fernandes finds Row Z.
 Share 24m ago 13.00 EST 69 min Lacey gives the ball away near the half-way line and concedes a free kick as he tries to make amends.
 Share 25m ago 12.58 EST 67 min Lacey has already sent in a cross. A moment later, Mbeumo slides a shot past the near post.
 Share 26m ago 12.57 EST 66 min Here come the subs, as advertised. Off go Tielemans (who scored), Dalot (who had, sad to say, a shocker) and Amad (who was better than the other night).
 Share 28m ago 12.56 EST 64 min Carrick, who has nothing to lose now, is preparing three subs: Mount, Dorgu and Lacey.
 Share Updated at  12.56 EST 30m ago 12.54 EST 62 min Fernandes plays a square pass to Cunha, whose shot goes wide. There seems to have been a deflection as it brings a corner, which comes to nowt.
 Share 31m ago 12.53 EST 61 min Amad wins a free kick off Goretzka. A chance for Fernandes to get a rare assist?
 Share 31m ago 12.52 EST 60 min A United attack, patient by the standards of this crazy match, leads to another left-foot shot from Tielemans, not nearly as good as the one that supplied the equaliser.
 Share 33m ago 12.51 EST 60 min United, who had crept up to 18th, are now 19th again, saved from the bottom only by their goal difference. It’s bad (-7), but only half as bad as Palace’s (-14).
 Share 34m ago 12.50 EST 57 min Mbeumo, slipped in by Cunha, gets a shot on target but (a) it’s easily saved and (b) the flag is up.
 Share 36m ago 12.48 EST 56 min Tielemans, who was so good for half an hour, now plays a hospital pass and the upshot is that Heaven goes into the book for stopping a quick break.
 Share Updated at  12.48 EST 37m ago 12.47 EST 55 min Carrick, seeing that, bowed his head and pinched the furrow between his eyes, as if he couldn’t believe them.
 Share 39m ago 12.45 EST GOAL! Man United 2-4 Villa (Goretzka 53)
 You couldn’t make it up. Yoro almost heads into his own net, there’s a goalmouth scramble, Goretzka keeps calm and puts it away. And once again, United have conceded two at the start of a half.
 View image in fullscreen Aston Villa's Leon Goretzka (L) shoots to score the team's fourth goal. Photograph: Darren Staples/AFP/Getty Images Share Updated at  13.05 EST 41m ago 12.43 EST 52 min McGinn wins a free kick off Fernandes, whose reaction you may just be able to guess.
 Share 42m ago 12.41 EST 51 min Mazraoui gets away down the right, only to send his cross curling out for a goal kick.
 Share 43m ago 12.40 EST 50 min That wasn’t in the script. But it was on brand for poor Dalot.
 Share 44m ago 12.39 EST GOAL!! United 2-3 Villa (McGinn pen 48)
 John McGinn slams it in, and yet again United have started a half badly.
 View image in fullscreen John McGinn of Aston Villa scores. Photograph: Conor Molloy/ProSports/Shutterstock Share Updated at  12.48 EST 45m ago 12.38 EST Penalty to Villa!
 Dalot lunges at Alysson, who goes down – and the whistle goes. It’s unlikely to be overturned.
 View image in fullscreen Alysson Edward of Aston Villa is fouled by Diogo Dalot of Manchester United resulting in a penalty. Photograph: Carl Recine/Getty Images Share Updated at  13.09 EST 47m ago 12.36 EST 46 min United sub: Maguire is off, presumed injured. Ayden Heaven is on – not the more experienced Matthijs de Ligt.
